basic_details.job_title: IOP Bhubaneswar Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Under IOP Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026, there is one Research Associate position under the DAE Raja Ramanna Chair (DAE-RRC) at the Institute of Physics (IOP), Bhubaneswar. The selected person will work on a project to improve the performance of the 3 MV Tandem Pelletron Accelerator. The appointment is for two years, and the fellowship is ₹35,000 + 18% HRA per month or ₹42,000 + 18% HRA per month, depending on qualification and experience. Candidates with a B.E/B. Tech or M.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Electronics or related fields should email their CV, certificates and statement of purpose

qualification.details: Candidates need one of the following qualifications, as printed in the notice: | B.E/B. Tech in Electrical Engineering / Electronics and related fields with a minimum of 60 % marks or equivalent CGPA from a recognized university/institution, with two years' experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or R&D organisations. or M.Tech in Power Electronics, Control System, Instrumentation and related field in Electrical Engineering / Electronics with a minimum of 65 % marks or equivalent CGPA from IIT or NIT or recognized university. B.E/B. Tech with four years' experiences or M.Tech with two years' experience or Doctoral degree in Engineering or Technology in the above mentioned fields can also be considered.

content_sections.heading: About IOP Bhubaneswar Research Associate
content_sections.text: The Institute of Physics, Bhubaneswar, is an autonomous research institution of the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India, located in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. This Research Associate position is under the DAE Raja Ramanna Chair (DAE-RRC) held by Dr Manmath Kumar Badapanda, FNAE. The work supports the 3 MV Tandem Pelletron Accelerator at IOP, Bhubaneswar.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates need one of the following qualifications, as printed in the notice: B.E/B. Tech in Electrical Engineering / Electronics and related fields with a minimum of 60 % marks or equivalent CGPA from a recognized university/institution, with two years' experience in R&D in industrial and academic institutions or R&D organisations. or M.Tech in Power Electronics, Control System, Instrumentation and related field in Electrical Engineering / Electronics with a minimum of 65 % marks or equivalent CGPA from IIT or NIT or recognized university. B.E/B. Tech with four years' experiences or M.Tech with two years' experience or Doctoral degree in Engineering or Technology in the above mentioned fields can also be considered. Preference will be given to candidates with experience in regulated DC power supplies, Power Electronics, control-interlock-protection system, Power semiconductor devices and their drive circuits, Transistors & OPAMPs, etc. A valid GATE score is desirable for candidates whose only qualification is a B.E/B.Tech. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IOP Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy. The notice advertises a single Research Associate position under the DAE Raja Ramanna Chair at the Institute of Physics, Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IOP Bhubaneswar Research Associate post?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 November 2026. The application and the two letters of recommendation from referees must be emailed on or before this date.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IOP Bhubaneswar Research Associate post?
faq.answer: You need a B.E/B. Tech in Electrical Engineering / Electronics and related fields with at least 60% marks and two years' R&D experience. Alternatively, you need an M.Tech in Power Electronics, Control System, Instrumentation or a related field with at least 65% marks from IIT, NIT or a recognized university.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the IOP Bhubaneswar Research Associate?
faq.answer: The fellowship is ₹35,000 + 18% HRA per month for B.E/B. Tech with two years' experiences or equivalent. It is ₹42,000 + 18% HRA per month for B.E/B. Tech with four years' experiences or equivalent.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the IOP Bhubaneswar Research Associate fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice lists 18% HRA per month on top of the fellowship of ₹35,000 or ₹42,000, which is paid as per IoP/DAE Rules.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the IOP Bhubaneswar Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Email your complete CV, degree and experience certificates and a brief one-page statement of purpose, in .pdf format, to [email protected] with a cc to [email protected]. Do this on or before 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IOP Bhubaneswar Research Associate post?
faq.answer: Applications will be shortlisted, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IOP Bhubaneswar Research Associate post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is for two years, with a performance evaluation at the end of each year. It may be extended until the end of Dr Manmath Kumar Badapanda's DAE-RRC tenure.

faq.question: Q9. Is a GATE score required for the IOP Bhubaneswar Research Associate post?
faq.answer: A valid GATE score is desirable, not essential, for candidates whose only qualification is a B.E/B.Tech.
